Maria (Finance): Heads up — noticed ~12k tokens missing from invoices for 2025-05-28 00:00-06:00 window. Likely ingestion delay. Filing ticket INC-4521. @raj @anya any quick takes? :eyes:
LedgerBot: Alert: delayed-usage-ingest detected (INC-4521) — backlog 12,432 tokens queued. See /incidents/4521
Raj (Eng): Looking — consumer lagged due to spike + backpressure on kafka consumer group. Retries piled up. Root cause candidate: consumer commit interval too long after forwarding failure.
Anya (Billing): If true we need invoice correction plan + customer credits. Do we have a safe backfill that preserves original timestamps?
Raj (Eng): Yes backfill script exists but we need to reprocess with dedupe by event_id. I can run in dry-run first. Timeline: dry-run today, full run tomorrow if green.
Tom (Ops): Customer comms: we'll need templated msg + opt-in credit. I'll draft and loop legal. Owning comms -> Tom. Target to send by 2025-06-12.
Maria (Finance): Action items: 1) Raj -> fix consumer config + dry-run backfill (owner: Raj) 2) Anya -> run invoice corrections & credits (owner: Anya) 3) Tom -> customer comms (owner: Tom) 4) Maria -> postmortem + recurrence checklist. Deadlines? Suggest Raj EOD today for config, backfill tomorrow, Anya final credits by 2025-06-17.
Raj (Eng): Ack. I'll bump commit interval, add circuit breaker, and add metric alert for consumer lag. Snippet I'll apply:
```
consumer.commitIntervalMs = 5000
max.poll.interval.ms = 300000
// add retry and circuit-breaker wrapper
```
Dry-run results posted to INC-4521.
Anya (Billing): I'll prepare credit manifest and run in staging. Will require finance signoff. Requesting Maria to approve credit thresholds. Also will open invoice adjustment PR.
Maria (Finance): Confirming credit thresholds: auto-credit up to $100 per affected account, manual review above. Approve: :white_check_mark:
LedgerBot: INC-4521 status update: dry-run completed — 12,432 tokens matched, 99.9% de-dupe success. Next step: schedule run 'full-backfill-20250612'
Tom (Ops): I'll queue the comms draft in #customer-updates and ping legal. Also setting a follow-up sync tomorrow 10:30am PT. Invite: @raj @anya
Raj (Eng): On it. After backfill will roll out consumer config change to prod with canary. Monitoring dashboard: /dashboards/consumer-lag
Anya (Billing): Post-backfill checklist: invoice delta report, credit ledger update, accounting journal entry. I'll attach docs in INC-4521.
Maria (Finance): Great. Let's reconvene after the run. Thanks team.
